recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not edit current Medication for FHIR-8063; any cleanup of stale unreferenced historical Medication package-form value-set or binding entries should be handled under a separate terminology/build-scope cleanup issue.
issue_request: FHIR-8063 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy correction from the DSTU1 May 2015 ballot asking that the MedicationContainer / Medication.package.container value-set link stop pointing to route-of-administration contents and instead use package-form contents, specifically SNOMED CT concepts is-a 408102007.
initial_application: Commit 534313123abc479f1c95a22956d9992582f9743c listed 8063 in its subject and changed source/medication/valueset-medication-package-form-codes.xml from SNOMED CT 284009009 to 408102007. The current old value-set source still contains the 408102007 compose.
additional_context: FHIR-8066 reported the same route-code/package-code problem and is already audited on the combined branch. FHIR-12347 later moved the then-current container binding to an EDQM-derived local list, and GF #13879 later removed Medication.package.container. Current Medication remains active but exposes Medication.packageSize rather than Medication.package.container; only the old package-form value-set file and bindings.ini registry entry remain as historical leftovers.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested correction was applied historically, and there is no current Medication.package.container binding surface that could mislead implementers in the current build.

related_jiras.note: Reported the same Medication.package.container route-code/package-code problem and already has a combined-branch no-change audit.
